concrete.src: R10 general notes (Jan 2025): C25/30. Site pour orders say C35 (lib/concrete/pourOrder.ts); the drawings' grade is used for capacity so it stays on the safe side.

steel.src: R10 general notes: high tensile H = 500 N/mm2

stiffness.src: Cracked-section modifiers in the usual range (ACI 318 6.6.3.1.1 / EN 1998-1 4.3.1(7) gives 0.5 for all); same model used for gravity and lateral

soil.src: R10 general notes: estimated bearing capacity 400 kN/m2 at 4.0 m depth, from the geotechnical investigation report

dead.src: 50 mm screed + tiles + soffit plaster 1.5, services 0.25 (common Ghana/UK practice); roof: screed to falls + waterproofing + terrace tiles 2.5

walls.src: Sandcrete block walls plastered both sides (Structville unit weights; Tarmac block data): 225 hollow 3.5 kN/m2 x ~2.9 m = 10 kN/m round the edge; internal 150 hollow walls (8-9 kN/m) spread as 2.5 kPa until the plan walls are read in as line loads (EN 1991-1-1 6.3.1.2(8) says walls over 3 kN/m should be line loads)

imposed.src: EN 1991-1-1 Table 6.2: dwellings 2.0, private balconies 2.5, stairs 3.0 (cat A range 2-4), accessible roof/terrace 2.0; seismic mass psiE = phi x psi2 (EN 1998-1 4.2.4): 0.15 floors, 0.3 roof

stairs.src: 175 mm waist + 150/250 steps, on plan; tiled

pool.src: R10 swimming pool GA (sheet 56): pool hangs below the 1st floor (SSL +3900) on 1800x300 wall-beams to a 250 mm base slab at SSL +2100; water depth assumed 1.5 m

lifts.src: Machine-room-less lift: rail/car/counterweight reactions at the top of each shaft, typical 8-person lift; replace with the supplier's figures

roof_tanks.src: None in the record yet: add {x_mm, y_mm, kN} for each water tank on the roof

wind.src: Ghana Building Code Part 5 Table 5.8: Accra 29 m/s 3-s gust (50 yr), converted to a 10-min mean of about 20 m/s for EN 1991-1-4; terrain category III (suburban); torsion e = b/10 (EN 1991-1-4 7.1.2)

seismic.src: Ghana Building Code: Accra in zone 3, ag = 0.35 g (hazard studies give 0.06-0.2 g at 475 yr; 0.20 g run as a sensitivity). EN 1998-1 type 1 spectrum, envelope of ground types B and C until Vs30 is measured; importance class II; DCM dual system q = 3.0 (3.6 if regular; 2.0 if torsionally flexible -- checked by the model)

combinations.src: EN 1990 Eq. 6.10 (STR), 6.12b (seismic), characteristic SLS for bearing pressures
